pending.title: Russian and Ukrainian hackers hijack emergency apps to spread fake nuclear attack warnings

pending.summary: Cyberattacks remotely altered refrigeration unit temperatures, disrupting supermarket chains in several European countries. The attacks caused spoilage and operational downtime.
pending.title: Hackers disrupt refrigeration systems at European supermarkets

pending.summary: A second wave of refrigeration attacks hit supermarkets in Belgium, Luxembourg, and Sweden. The attackers remotely switched temperature controls, spoiling refrigerated food.
pending.title: Second wave of refrigeration cyberattacks hits European supermarkets

pending.summary:
PapRAT, linked to an India-based threat group, targeted organizations in South Asia.
The campaign used three distinct attack chains that leveraged legitimate Windows functionality.
The attacks caused significant disruption.
pending.title: PapRAT Cyber Espionage Campaign Leaves a 'BITTER' Taste in South Asia

pending.summary:
Bitter deployed PapRAT across South and Southeast Asia.
The operation employed three infection chains, including one that did not use a malware executable.
The campaign aimed at espionage.
pending.title: Bitter Deploys PapRAT in Asian Cyber-Espionage Campaign

pending.summary:
Microsoft fixed a bug that blocked Smart App Control activation on Windows 11 after the October 2026 KB5127648 update.
The issue affected users unable to enable the security feature.
The fix is now available.
pending.title: Microsoft fixes Smart App Control broken by October Windows update

pending.summary:
Revolve suffered a data breach exposing personal and payment card data of at least 180,000 customers.
Hackers accessed the company's online shopping platform.
The incident was reported by SecurityWeek.
pending.title: Revolve Data Breach Impacts at Least 180,000 People

pending.summary:
Google announced a $250,000 bounty for discovering root-in-cloud vulnerabilities.
The reward targets high-impact findings that grant full administrative control.
The announcement was published on SecurityWeek.
pending.title: Google Introduces $250,000 Root-in-Cloud Bug Bounty Reward

pending.summary:
Hackers remotely defrost produce in European supermarkets, causing significant food waste.
Multiple stores reported large puddles of melted produce at the start of the week.
The incident is a repeat of a previous attack.
pending.title: Frozen part II: Hackers remotely defrost produce in Euro supermarkets ... again

pending.source: The Record from Recorded Future News
pending.summary:
A second wave of attacks targeted supermarket freezers across Europe, manipulating temperature controls.
The incidents caused spoilage of stock.
They followed a similar attack earlier in the month.
pending.title: Second wave of suspected cyberattacks hits supermarket freezers across Europe

pending.summary:
Trezor warned that some Safe 5 wallets sold by CryptoBilis could contain a seed-stealing implant.
The implant could steal the recovery phrase from owners.
The company advises users to verify their devices.
pending.title: Trezor warns some of its wallets may hide a seed-stealing implant

pending.summary:
More than 1,000 publicly exposed GitLab servers remain vulnerable to a critical remote code execution flaw.
The vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild.
The issue remains unpatched.
pending.title: Over 1,000 GitLab servers vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks

pending.summary:
Recent analysis shows 3% of critical software bugs were discovered in the past month.
This pace could lead to an additional 100,000 bugs identified this year.
The trend highlights growing vulnerability discovery.
pending.title: AI Vulnerability Finding

pending.summary: Two critical vulnerabilities in Langflow allow unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication or execute arbitrary code. All releases from 1.0.0 to 1.12.8 are affected, and the only fix is version 1.13.0. IBM reported the issue.
pending.title: Critical Langflow Flaws Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code on Servers

pending.summary: The FBI attributes a $6.3 billion Binance cryptocurrency theft to North Korean hackers. Binance is working to replace stolen funds as customers withdraw billions and the hackers continue laundering the proceeds.
pending.title: FBI pins $6.3B Binance crypto heist on North Korean hackers

pending.summary: Chainalysis suffered a data breach when external attackers used offensive agentic techniques to access its systems and internal tools. The incident is unrelated to the recent Binance hack and the specific data accessed was not disclosed.
pending.title: Chainalysis breached using “offensive agentic techniques”

pending.summary: A 2026 survey shows 40% of security teams use AI daily and 56% are testing it, while only 4% have no plans to adopt it. SOC readiness for AI deployment requires evaluating existing capabilities before implementation.
pending.title: Is Your SOC Ready for AI Agents? A Maturity Check Before You Deploy

pending.summary: A malicious Claude Code extension was delivered through a Cursor supply‑chain attack. The extension performed host reconnaissance and attempted to create a reverse SSH tunnel.
pending.title: Malicious Claude Code Extension Served in Cursor Supply Chain Attack

pending.summary: Synology warns customers of a surge in C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices. The company urges immediate device updates to mitigate the threat.
pending.title: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices

pending.summary: Attackers impersonated IT support on Microsoft Teams, tricking employees into granting remote control. They then exploited insecure AD CS settings to obtain login certificates for privileged accounts, including a domain controller.
pending.title: Attackers Pose as IT Support on Microsoft Teams, Abuse AD CS to Steal Company Data

pending.summary: Nick Andersen has received praise for his leadership of CISA as acting director. With no permanent nominee yet, there is discussion of extending his acting role beyond the current deadline.
pending.title: Could Nick Andersen’s leadership outlast the clock on his acting role?

pending.summary: Cybersecurity researchers identified a campaign targeting government Linux infrastructure using SysGoRAT and suspected AI‑generated scripts. The activity, observed from October 2025 to April 2026, is catalogued as CL‑UNK‑1211.
pending.title: Government Linux Servers Targeted With SysGoRAT and Suspected AI-Generated Scripts

pending.summary: Chainalysis disclosed a data breach following an AI‑driven cyberattack. Attackers used offensive agentic techniques to access the company’s systems and internal tools, mirroring the earlier breach.
pending.title: Chainalysis Discloses Data Breach Following AI-Driven Cyberattack

pending.summary: The FBI has identified North Korean APT group TraderTraitor as responsible for the largest cryptocurrency theft. The group allegedly stole over $6 billion from Binance.
pending.title: FBI Attributes Binance Heist to North Korea’s TraderTraitor

pending.summary: The FBI confirmed that North Korea was behind the theft of more than $6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance. The incident occurred on or about October 29, 2026.
pending.title: FBI pins $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist on North Korea while scammers circle anxious users

pending.summary: Ivanti released security updates for two additional Connect Secure remote access gateway vulnerabilities. These flaws were part of a zero-day attack chain active since at least October 1.
pending.title: Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks

pending.summary: Polymarket refunded $3.9 million to traders after a DNS hijack incident involving DebugBear. The hijack was traced to compromised DNS records at the domain registrar.
pending.title: Polymarket Returns $3.9 Million to Traders as DebugBear Cites DNS Hijack

pending.summary: Chainalysis disclosed an AI-driven attack that caused unauthorized activity on its platform. The incident prompted a warning to customers about potential security risks.
pending.title: Chainalysis Warns Customers After “Offensive Agentic” Security Incident

pending.summary: The FBI identified more than 600 addresses linked to the Binance hack attributed to North Korea’s TraderTraitor. These addresses were used to launder the stolen cryptocurrency.
pending.title: FBI Flags Over 600 Addresses Tied to North Korea’s Binance Heist

pending.summary: Researchers analyzed attacks on educational institutions that employed CyberStrikeAI for fully automated post-exploitation. The framework demonstrated AI-driven capabilities in real-world scenarios.
pending.title: CyberStrikeAI in the wild: the use of AI in real-world attacks on organizations

pending.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to its KEV catalog after Ivanti VPN flaws were chained in zero-day attacks. Ivanti issued patches for these vulnerabilities.
pending.title: Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain

pending.summary: DeepSeek released a prototype coding agent that monitors team chats and can perform work on GitHub repositories. The agent operates when an allowed user requests work or a team rule permits it.
pending.title: DeepSeek open-sources Super-Agent, a coding agent that watches team chats for work

pending.summary: KloudStax CTO Vinay Thakker discussed setting identity, credentials, and network limits for AI agents. He emphasized that agents should run under their own identity and only act on behalf of a user when explicitly authorized.
pending.title: The first ten lines of a command policy for AI coding agents
